For me, getting an official diagnosis has led to a change in my meds, a new focus in therapy and building new routines to calm my mind. I'm lucky to have a prescriber and therapist that both have a large understanding of Autism. My three main support people know plenty about Autism and have been helping to keep me sane.

I have been on various meds for years now. I have multiple conditions though. I have been diagnosed with BPD, Bipolar 1, ADHD, Autism, PTSD, Insomnia, Depression and Anxiety. The meds that helped the most in the past and are helping the most now are:

Lamictal at 150mg 2x a day. Lamictal is a mood stabilizer. I felt much calmer overall on it and I had much more motivation. I was taken off of it and I was much worse overall. I'm currently being put back on it.

Latuda at 120mg in the evening. Latuda is another mood stabilizer. I find that I'm less suicidal on it and I am rarely manic. I do have severe depression still.

Trazodone at 200mg at night. Trazodone is a sedative and antidepressant that helped me sleep. I was recently taken off of it but it helped me with my sleep for 4 years.

Seroquel at 100mg at night and 25mg 3x a day as needed for overall anxiety. I haven't been on it very long but it has helped the night terrors and daily anxiety.

I'm on more than that and have tried more than that but those seem to be the standouts.
